title: Step by step Dance TUTORIAL for Ankhiyon Se Goli Mare song | Shipra's Dance Class

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor breaks down choreography step-by-step with clear counting and directional cues. She combines detailed footwork analysis with upper body and facial expression guidance.

lesson_structure.note: Welcome and overview of the tutorial
Detailed breakdown of the first gun-shot and eye-wink step
Demonstration with music for the first section
Detailed breakdown of hip movement and eye blink sequence
Demonstration with music for the second section
Demonstration with music for the third section

common_mistakes: Moving feet instead of only bending knees

steps_taught.name: Gun Shot & Wink
steps_taught.description: Right toe pointed, hands shape a gun gesture, shoot and blow.

steps_taught.name: Hip Bends
steps_taught.description: Hands on waist, bending knees with hip movement right and left.

steps_taught.name: Eye Blinking
steps_taught.description: Hands on waist, blinking right eye and moving eyeballs in directions.

what_works: Clear breakdown of footwork and hand positions separately
Repeated counts and practice sections with music
what_hinders: Pacing can be fast during continuous explanations

quotes.text: Practice karne wale hai Ankhiyon Se Goli Maare song ke upar
Song start hota hai woh gun shot se start hota hai
Sirf knees ke upar hume bend karna hai, pairo ko move nahi karenge

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor facing front, demonstrating foot and hand placement for the gun-shot move

extraction.distinctive_method: Uses vivid imagery like reloading and shooting a gun to anchor hand placement and timing.
